331 / 331S: Cortech Summit Veldura Stool
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-331-summit-veldura-stool
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/summit-veldura-stool/
Spec sheets: 330 / 331, Bolt-down installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Summit Veldura Stool – 331 / 331S
Current H1: Cortech Summit Stool with Veldura - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 331
Subtitle: Compact Molded Stool with a Veldura Soft-Touch Finish and an Optional Ballast Door
Current subtitle: Cortech 331 Summit Veldura Stool with Soft-Touch Exterior for Behavioral Health Care Facilities
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Summit Veldura Stool is the Summit Stool with a Veldura soft-touch finish, for patient rooms, dayrooms, and group spaces in behavioral healthcare and other secure settings. The soft-touch surface adds comfort and warmth without giving up durability.
The stool is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with rounded edges and no steel or wood components. It can be weighted at the factory, or the 331S can be filled with sandbags on site through a ballast door. The Summit Veldura Stool is rated for outdoor use.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Finish: Veldura soft-touch exterior
Dimensions: 20”W×21”D×18”H
Weight: 12 lbs
Weighting: Factory sand ballasting optional; the 331S has a ballast door for adding sandbags on site that closes with tamper-resistant screws. Do not use loose sand
Outdoor Use: Rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
331 – Veldura: Without ballast door
331S – Veldura with Ballast Door: Ballast door for adding sandbags on site
Installation and Options
Weighting: Factory weighted, or add sandbags on site through the ballast door on the 331S; do not use loose sand. Hardware bit size is T27
[H2] Applications
The Summit Veldura Stool suits rooms that want small, safe seating with a softer feel.
Typical applications include:
Patient rooms and dayrooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Group rooms and shared areas in residential treatment centers
Classrooms and other secure settings
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Summit Series
The Cortech Summit Series is a line of molded seating and tables with a calm, residential look, made for behavioral healthcare facilities and other secure settings. Most Summit seating comes in a standard molded finish or with a Veldura soft-touch exterior.
The Summit Series includes:
Chairs: Guest Chair (300 / 301), Accent Chair (310 / 311), and Lounge Chair (320 / 321)
Stools: Summit Stool (330 / 331)
Tables: Side Table (342 / 343), Mid-Range Table (353 / 354), and All Purpose Table (361 / 363 / 364)
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (54 characters): Cortech Summit Veldura Stool - 331 / 331S at Anchortex
Meta description (153 characters): Shop the Cortech Summit Veldura Stool. A compact molded stool with a Veldura soft-touch finish and an optional ballast door for behavioral health spaces.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Summit Series" is a new section for the Summit chairs, stools, and tables. It is the same on each Summit page.
H1: Cortech calls it the Summit Veldura Stool. I took out "One-Piece Rotationally Molded" and "Model," and added the 331S.
Variant names and prices: your variants are named "311 - No ballast door" and "311S - Ballast door," which are the Summit Veldura Accent Chair model numbers, and their prices ($739.20 / $880.00) are the same as on the 311 Accent Chair page. The SKUs (C601227-01 and -02) are not the 311 SKUs. Would you like the variants renamed "331 - No ballast door" and "331S - Ballast door"? Can you check the prices?
Description: your current page describes the Summit Accent Chair ("order style 310") instead of the stool. I wrote the stool description.
Weight: your variants are set to 255 lbs, which looks like a placeholder. The Cortech spec sheet gives 12 lbs for the Summit Stool and no separate weight for the Veldura version, so I used 12 lbs.
Bolt-down: Cortech has bolt-down instructions for the Summit Stool with a floor plate fitted at the ballast door. They do not say whether the plate is sold separately, so I left floor mounting out.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says the Summit Veldura Stool is rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized, so I added it to the description.
Product images: the page has four images: two stool photos and two Summit color charts. The Cortech product page has one more photo (Summit Veldura Stool in Tide). Would you like me to add it?
